answer: One enforceable rule: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The vertex of work and the ripple of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a dune to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
